rv.q: The scene then crosses the continent to a New Mexico residential spa where Pearl's former lover Evelyn (Rebecca De Mornay) lounges after a kickboxing session. There's an encounter between her and Soochi (Christina Toth), who manages Pearl's restaurant, and it becomes evident that something sinister has been arranged.

If you’re interested in exploring the creative process of theatre, The Pushover may work for you as I’m sure the play will be constantly adjusting itself throughout the run, and I expect (hope) that it will be a different play at the end of the run than the beginning.

vr.q: The script, while full of Shanley's characteristic wit, doesn't really give the audience someone to root for.
